description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" and an unspecified variable on the x-axis, comparing four different models or configurations. The x-axis is labeled with values ranging from 128 to 1024, with a linear scale and tick labels at each data point. The y-axis is labeled "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" and ranges from 0.0 to 0.5, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot displays four lines, each representing a different model or configuration: LlaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep (blue, circle markers, solid line), Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep (orange, square markers, solid line), LlaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench (green, triangle markers, solid line), and Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench (red, diamond markers, solid line). The blue line starts at approximately 0.18 and increases to around 0.37 at x=512, remaining steady at 0.37 until x=1024. The orange line begins at about 0.09, rises to 0.42 at x=512, and then remains steady at 0.42 until x=1024. The green line starts at around 0.05, increases to 0.37 at x=512, and remains steady at 0.37 until x=1024. The red line begins at approximately 0.25, increases to 0.42 at x=512, and then continues to rise to around 0.52 at x=1024.
